authority.scope: new secondary analysis of already exposed Wearable source39 only; prior studies stay closed

preprocessing: native raw crop first, contiguous float64; public A0/legacy entry uncentered; fixed seven-band filter; ITCCA and unitTRCA channel-time centering after filtering; no metadata/manifest/QC/processed EEG access; upstream distributed downsampling not revalidated as online causal

decoder.A0: public FBCCA same raw crop and bank; score normalized by sum filter weights
decoder.ITCCA: each class template is mean of first k filtered labeled trials; maximum regularized canonical correlation query versus template; sum_f(w_f*rho_f^2)/sum_f(w_f)
decoder.ITCCA_covariance: center each channel in time; covariance/(N-1); add .01*trace(C)/channels*I separately to query/template covariance; inverse square root eigen cutoff max(eps,largest*1e-12), exact public cca_score constant-energy rules; clip rho to [0,1]
decoder.AQ_ITCCA: (1-lambda)*softmax(A0score/T0) + lambda*softmax(ITCCAscore/T); lambda0 returns exact A0 without recomputation
decoder.FB_eTRCA_unit: diagnostic implementation variant, not author-bitwise reproduction; time-center each filtered support/query channel; Q=sum_b X_b X_b.T; S=(sum_b X_b)(sum_b X_b).T-Q; generalized eigh largest algebraic eigenvector normalized to unit Euclidean norm per class; ensemble all class filters; center each projected component in time before flattened Pearson; sum_f(w_f*r_f)/sum_f(w_f)
decoder.legacy_FB_eTRCA: existing public predict_filterbank_ensemble_trca, ridge1e-6, original raw crop; existing unnormalized signed-square filter score; untouched historical comparator
decoder.uniform_shrinkage: same frozen AQ lambda; replace support posterior by exact uniform1/12; BA must equal A0 since lambda<=.75
decoder.wrong_label_support: all 11 nonidentity cyclic permutations of support class labels, same permutation across blocks, equivalent to rolling ITCCA score columns1..11; frozen true-label AQ lambda/T and A0; average metrics not posteriors; no re-fit
decoder.k0: all available methods exact A0 alias; wrong_label permutations0/no intervention; no fabricated standalone ITCCA/TRCA at unavailable budgets
decoder.degenerate: nonpositive correlation denominator gives0; Pearson clip[-1,1]; log probability floor1e-300; argmax first class on exact tie

fitting.outer_folds: sorted39 source list position modulo3; each fold fit26, development-evaluate13; all three fit freezes published before evaluation
fitting.fusion_candidate_order: first lambda0/temperature null; then lambda .25,.5,.75 in that order each with ascending31 T; 94 candidates; exact objective tie first candidate
fitting.fit_unit: window samples and available support budget; pool dry/wet equally over fit26 and fixed60queries; never interface-conditioned or metadata-conditioned heads
fitting.A0_temperature: one standalone NLL-minimizing temperature per window, same at all budgets
fitting.AQ_fit: one joint lambda and T per window and k1/3/5, minimize actual fused posterior NLL, not standalone support NLL
fitting.standalone_temperatures: independent standalone NLL-minimizing T for ITCCA at each window*k1/3/5, unitTRCA and legacyTRCA at each window*k3/5; do not reuse fusion T for standalone NLL

reporting.unit: participant39; equal means across all six conditions; descriptive cross-fitted development CIs, not independent confirmatory coverage
reporting.early_auc: BA0/6 + BA1/2 + BA3/3; k5 separate learning-curve diagnostic
reporting.primary: all6cells participant eAUC(AQ_ITCCA)-eAUC(A0): mean>=.01 and one-sided95LCB>0
reporting.interface_safety: each dry/wet separately eAUC(AQ_ITCCA)-eAUC(A0): mean>=-.005 and one-sided95LCB>-1/60
reporting.confidence_intervals: Student t df38 on39 participant vectors; sampleSD ddof1/sqrt39; one-sided95 t.ppf(.95), two-sided95 t.ppf(.975); shared training-fold dependence not corrected
reporting.diagnostics: all methods at all available budgets, per-cell/person harm, k3-to-k5 change, standalone probability calibration, uniform versus learned NLL, all11 wrong-label metrics, first observed budget reaching80percent; >5 if not reached; labeled trials12k; analyzed EEG seconds12k*N/250, not total elapsed session time
reporting.terminal_rule: all primary/supervised-specificity/k1/interface-safety gates pass => USEFUL_EEG_CALIBRATION_DEVELOPMENT, else AQ_NOT_ESTABLISHED; invariant failure is implementation failure not scientific conclusion
reporting.claim_boundary: neither terminal status establishes metadata contribution, calibration saving at useful accuracy, exact literature reproduction, SOTA superiority or independent confirmation; 80percent attainment is diagnostic only
